verdict.rationale: An email SaaS could plausibly publish a public API spec, so this axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and a probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The documented MCP server is a separate capability and does not count as a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
